# Files exempt from the AGPL-3.0-or-later header check
# (`.github/workflows/license-header.yml`).
#
# Format: one fnmatch glob per line. Comments start with `#`. Globs
# match the file path RELATIVE TO THE REPO ROOT, as `git diff
# --name-only` reports them.
#
# Keep this list short and justified. Anything that does not belong
# to AGPL-licensed core (generated artefacts, vendored snippets,
# upstream config files) is fair game; everything else MUST carry
# the header.

# ---- generated artefacts ----------------------------------------------------
# JSON Schema → Zod / Pydantic codegen output. Re-running the
# generator overwrites these files; a hand-written header would be
# stripped on the next regeneration.
packages/schemas/src/generated/*.ts
packages/schemas/src/generated/**/*.ts
packages/schemas/eidan_schemas/generated/*.py
packages/schemas/eidan_schemas/generated/**/*.py

# ---- test fixtures and conftest -------------------------------------------
# conftest is not "source" we ship; it carries the fixtures the test
# tree imports from. Test files themselves DO need the header.
**/conftest.py

# ---- Next.js scaffolding ---------------------------------------------------
# next-env.d.ts is fully owned by the Next.js CLI and overwritten on

apps/web/next-env.d.ts
